stories.headline: Could winter firewood demand rival a pulp mill?

stories.headline: Boise Cascade’s plywood prices rise as shipments fall
stories.body: Boise Cascade’s third-quarter results show why revenue growth alone does not describe mill activity. Plywood selling prices rose 31% from a year earlier, while plywood sales volumes fell 7%.

stories.headline: Forest pest forum registration closes November 13
stories.body: Registration for the 69th National Forest Pest Management Forum remains open through November 13. Natural Resources Canada organizes the November 17–19 meeting, with attendance in Ottawa or virtually through the Canadian Institute of Forestry.

featuredResource.title: The Hardwood Log Desktop Reference Book
featuredResource.description: This PDF reference book brings together hardwood log-volume tables, log-rule conversions, defect deductions and grading and bucking guidance. It helps loggers, foresters and buyers compare measurements and estimate log value using consistent reference tables.
